sections.title: Imports for project display
sections.what: Brings in the formatters for budget, capacity, and assessment.
sections.why: Reason not stated in the code.

sections.name: toUIProjectListItem
sections.title: Project list display fields
sections.what: Adds formatted budget, capacity, and likelihood to a project record. Budget uses the planned budget if present, otherwise the older budget field.
sections.why: Lets list screens show readable values directly.
sections.watch_out: The fallback to the older budget field means the two sources can mix.

sections.name: toUIProjectDetail
sections.title: Project detail display fields
sections.what: Starts from the list version and adds a formatted confidence score.
sections.why: Detail pages show more information than lists.
sections.watch_out: Fields are copied twice, so a field in both places is overwritten by the list version.

summary: Adds display-ready budget, capacity, and assessment text to project records from the server.
purpose: Lets project screens show readable numbers without formatting them each time.
why: Reason not stated in the code. The original server data is kept, and formatted fields are added beside it.
how: Copies the server record, then adds formatted budget, capacity, and likelihood. The detail version also adds a formatted confidence score.
inputs: A project record from the server, typed as any.
outputs: A copy of the record with extra formatted fields.
risks: The input is not typed or checked, so a missing field can produce empty or odd text.
debug: If a formatted value looks wrong, check the matching raw field in the server data and the formatter in projectDisplay.
